description: Read session data for a tab via BrowserGPT extension: chrome.cookies (HttpOnly), optional localStorage/sessionStorage keys. Operator must approve the in-tab permission prompt. Use for session export / porting auth; do not paste values into chat.

confirmation_message.description: Plain-language permission prompt for the operator (no secrets or template syntax).

local_storage_keys.description: Optional localStorage key names to read on the target tab

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

session_storage_keys.description: Optional sessionStorage key names to read on the target tab

name: browser_get_cookies
